protocol.source_profile: leave-one-utterance-out mean of normalized same-speaker source aggregates (3 other auxiliary validation utterances)
protocol.target_profile: equal-weight normalized per-file centroid of Track5-8, existing speaker windows
protocol.speaker_windows: 6s nonoverlap; tail >=1.5s; RMS>=0.001; RMS0.04 fbank80 Hamming CMN, no VAD
protocol.source_similarity: max(mean window cosine, normalized duration-weighted aggregate cosine); descriptive, not the Fixed-Male profile
protocol.asr: offline Whisper-small language zh task transcribe max_new_tokens256; existing forced_decoder_ids/attention-mask settings unchanged
protocol.cer: existing evaluator cer() punctuation/case/OpenCC t2s; separately source-ASR and declared manifest text references; micro=sum edits/sum reference chars
protocol.utmos: not evaluated in this diagnostic; no quality-gate acceptance or selection

limitations: Auxiliary validation selected the existing checkpoints; this is not an independent acceptance set or Fixed-Male result.

Whisper transcript errors and source-ASR reference errors can confound CER; manifest text is declared corpus metadata, not newly human-verified audio transcription.
Teacher PCM and supplied feature oracle use historical paired assets; native build is not historical bit parity.
Only one stage is replaced in each adjacent comparison, but numeric metric differences do not prove the cause of Fixed-Male failures.
